europe_now.title: Cyberattack Disrupts French Supermarket Operations
europe_now.summary: Hackers remotely heated refrigeration units in French supermarkets, sparking fires and spoiling food. The incident represents a significant security breach targeting commercial infrastructure within the country.

sources.headline: Hackers heat French supermarket fridges, sparking fires and spoiling food

europe_now.title: French Student Protests Enter Third Week
europe_now.summary: French youth have continued nationwide demonstrations demanding answers on education conditions for a third consecutive week. Protesters intend to maintain pressure on the government as rallies spread across the country.

sources.headline: French youth demand answers as education protests enter third week
France: Student protesters want to 'keep the pressure up on the government'

top_stories.title: Hungary Repeals Anti-LGBTQ Legislation
top_stories.summary: Hungarian MPs have voted to scrap legislation associated with the government that targeted LGBTQ-related content. This decision reverses previous measures and alters the country's existing social policy framework.

sources.headline: Hungarian MPs scrap Orbán's anti-LGBTQ measures

top_stories.title: Spanish Royals Visit Ceuta Amid Diplomatic Tensions
top_stories.summary: Spanish royals have undertaken a rare visit to the North African enclave of Ceuta amid ongoing diplomatic tensions with Morocco. The trip follows a recent migrant influx that has heightened security concerns and strained bilateral relations.

sources.headline: Spanish royals visit Ceuta amid tensions with Morocco over migrant influx
Spanish royals make rare visit to Ceuta after migrant crisis

top_stories.title: Russia Resumes Attacks on Ukrainian Cities
top_stories.summary: Russian forces have resumed attacks on Ukrainian cities while sparing energy infrastructure for the first time since a ceasefire. Ukrainian officials report they received no warning prior to the latest ballistic missile strike targeting Kyiv.

sources.headline: Russia pounds Ukrainian cities, spares energy targets for first time since Trump 'ceasefire'
Ukraine had ‘no warning’ of latest Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv

top_stories.title: French Candidate Calls for EU Budget Rebate
top_stories.summary: French presidential candidate Bruno Retailleau has argued that France should seek a rebate on its contribution to the European Union budget. The proposal highlights ongoing debates regarding national financial obligations within the bloc's fiscal framework.
